# Labor DiD matryoshka skeleton

Date: 2026-11-03

## Objective

Create a reviewable CAF labor-estimation skeleton without yet building cohorts, risk sets, outcomes,
or changing the station-opening pipeline.

## Scope

- Store the active model family in one compact specification table.
- Estimate every rolling risk set and baseline-service stratum separately.
- Extract only the focal cohort ATT(g,t) from each estimator call.
- Keep the opening year separate from the first-full-year summary.
- Weight first and additional treatment estimates by treated counts for the combined point estimate.
- Leave combined uncertainty pending a joint person-level bootstrap.

## Non-goals

Do not change station inputs, routing, accessibility, cohort construction, treatment assignment, or
outcome construction. Do not run estimators against restricted data.

## Verification

Format and parse touched R files, inspect the specification table, and confirm that the active DAG
does not yet require a risk-set target or the did package.
